problem_meta.instruction: Given the reactants and reagents below, come up with a possible product.
problem_meta.agent_answer:
The input is a **Miyaura borylation** reaction:

- **Aryl bromide substrate:**  
  `Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)n2nccc2-c2cn(S(=O)(=O)c3ccc(C)cc3)c3ncc(Br)cc23)cc1`
- **Boronating reagent:** bis(pinacolato)diboron, B₂pin₂
- **Catalyst system:** PdCl₂ with an iron/diphosphine ligand system
- **Base:** sodium acetate

The expected transformation is replacement of the aryl **C–Br** bond by an aryl **C–B(pin)** bond.

### Predicted major product

**Canonical SMILES:**

```text
Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)n2nccc2-c2cn(S(=O)(=O)c3ccc(C)cc3)c3ncc(B4OC(C)(C)C(C)(C)O4)cc23)cc1
```

This is the corresponding **aryl pinacol boronate ester**.

### Net transformation

```text
Ar–Br + B2pin2  →  Ar–B(pin)
```

The predicted product contains **one boron atom**, no bromine, and has the molecular formula:

```text
C30H31BN4O6S2
```

with calculated molecular weight approximately **618.18 g/mol**.
